custom_features.description: Features explicitly described by the user in the notes or description field that do not map to the 9 known feature modules. Extracted by Step 1.5b. Treated as highest priority — equal to user-selected checkbox features.

priority_hierarchy.1_explicit: User-selected checkbox features AND custom features from notes — equal highest priority
priority_hierarchy.4_on_demand: Generate only when user navigates there

types.screen_needed_false: Affects existing screens only — becomes a note_for_generation on relevant screens in the Project Brain screen plan. No new screen added.
types.screen_needed_true: Requires a new screen — added to project_brain.custom_screens with generation_priority in the primary queue alongside other explicit features.

custom_features.name: GST Calculation
custom_features.note_for_generation: Show GST line item on all invoices and checkout screens. Display tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive amounts.

custom_features.name: Multi-currency Support
custom_features.note_for_generation: Show currency selector on financial screens. Display converted amounts in user's preferred currency.

custom_features.name: Client Portal
custom_features.note_for_generation: Statement list with download button, filtered by date range. Client login separate from admin login.
